newsitem.title: USA: Tech Data's Vice Chairman Godwin to leave.
newsitem.headline: Tech Data's Vice Chairman Godwin to leave.

text.p: Tech Data Corp said on Monday that Tim Godwin is resigning as vice-chairman and member of the board effective January 31, 1997.
It was not immediately known whom would replace Godwin.
Godwin said that he plans to initially enjoy recreational activities before resuming his professional career.
Godwin joined the company in 1989 as senior vice president of finance and chief financial officer.
In 1991 he was named a board member and subsequently president and chief operating officer. He was named vice chairman in 1995, the company said.
